sources.title: GitHub - ClaudioSS01/portuguese-Bertimbau: Portuguese pre-trained BERT ...
sources.snippet: BERTimbau - Portuguese BERT This repository contains pre-trained BERT models trained on the Portuguese language. BERT-Base and BERT-Large Cased variants were trained on the BrWaC (Brazilian Web as Corpus), a large Portuguese corpus, for 1,000,000 steps, using whole-word mask. Model artifacts for TensorFlow and PyTorch can be found below.

sources.title: BERTimbau - Portuguese BERT-Large language model
sources.snippet: This resource contains a pre-trained BERT language model trained on the Portuguese language. A BERT-Large cased variant was trained on the BrWaC (Brazilian Web as Corpus), a large Portuguese corpus, for 1,000,000 steps, using whole-word mask.
